name: gimex::fsh::ClampRound (fsh_clamp_round)
notes: Lane MV. GimexFshConvert_ClampRound (the original and ours alone over seeded inputs; results and every byte written compared, stack cleared 0x00 and 0xff alternately). Mutants (filter gz_gimex_fsh_convert, 119 over two runs, shared by the group): 106 killed. Argued equivalent (9): 1-ulp changes to three double constants of RgbToYCbCrFloat (the results are cast to float), LumaWeight without the negative adjustment (the luma of a byte colour is never negative), the zero-weight divisor 1 to 2 (the sum is 0 then), ClampByte without the lower clamp (RoundToMultiple of a non-negative value is never negative), and in RgbToYuyv the neighbour pointers feeding PackYuyv's dead p0 / p3 (three mutants; the original's own output ignores them). Not killed (3): the failure-path frees of ReorderPlanes (two mutants; the harness has no allocation failure injection) and AllocateMipChain's truncate-of-sum vs sum-of-truncates (differs only for a negative height with a non-mask alignment; the test pool keeps heights non-negative so the allocation size stays sane). Not tested: pixel formats 0x16 / 0x1e through RgbToYuv420 / ReorderPlanes (the original overflows its heap buffer by 1 byte there, see ORIGINAL-BUG; ReorderImage itself is compared with a padded stride). Hooked at its RVA.
